items.title: Tommy Ridgley Interview, 1986-06-20
items.q: Bob Robbins was one of these people who had a lot of confidence in me.

ctx.x: River City. Bob Robin. Okay. Now, what year that could have been around? 1960? It's probably like 60s. Not very late. About 67, 60, 68, 69, somewhere around there. Okay. Yeah, because I was thinking, I remember when I was in that nightclub. And I was supposed to be running a nightclub. But anyway, Bob Robbins was one of these people who had a lot of confidence in me. And he said, man, I still think you got that hit record, that number one thing for the country. Yeah. We went to Baton Rouge and did this. And…
